serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Let’s go and visit Priestbot and Shanice.
Some time ago me and them talked about organizations that could, potentially, be quite dangerous to me and my bot.
Since then I asked Big Daddy about them and I learned many interesting things. Their names, what they want and things like that. 
I’m still not sure if it's a good idea to just tell Big Daddy’s secrets like that.
Shanice and Priestbot are trustworthy, but even then I don’t know if Big Daddy would feel comfortable with me telling them everything I learned…
